title: Worst app ever
body: I recently downloaded this app expecting access to premium features after paying, but I was sorely disappointed. Despite shelling out money, the premium features were still inaccessible. Additionally, the app tries to force you into purchasing subscriptions for other apps, which feels like a sneaky money grab. Overall, a complete waste of money and time. Avoid at all costs.
author: DomaDoma11

title: I was charged twice for a yearly subscription
body: I was charged twice for an annual subscription.  I first bought the whole package for a year and after a couple of months I wanted to pull up all the applications on another device.  Instead of renewing my subscription on a new device, I was charged again for a year.  I left a request from Apple to return my money for a subscription, and instead of $ 56, they returned $ 10 to me.  I would have given more stars if not for this situation..  Support didn't answer me.
